pages.text: Duma Money Market Fund factsheet, issued by Jua Asset Managers (SYN). Duma Money Market Fund is a money market fund and its objective is to preserve capital and provide daily liquidity. The management fee of Duma Money Market Fund is 1.4 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Duma Money Market Fund is SYN Sh 500, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 500. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Duma Money Market Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 11.2 percent.

Withdrawals from Duma Money Market Fund are paid within 1 business days. The main holdings of Duma Money Market Fund are Treasury bills (50 percent), call deposits (40 percent) and commercial paper (10 percent). Pwani Trustees (SYN) acts as trustee of Duma Money Market Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Duma Money Market Fund was launched in 2010 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall.
